label: WRONG
reason: An AST pass over every class in netbox/ipam/tables/*.py found that every tables.Column() call passes verbose_name=_(...), as in asn.py, fhrp.py, vrfs.py, vlans.py and services.py. The only outlier, AnnotatedIPAddressTable (ip.py:373), makes no Column() call at all. Its one column, a TemplateColumn, does pass verbose_name=_('IP Address'), so the tool misread it and the only outlier is not a violation (false_outliers). ruff in pyproject.toml has nothing that would enforce the rule. I hesitated with ACCEPT, because the translated-header convention is real and worth keeping.
